column1: # Rows db.hr1.* (line DBID hr-1, 2026-11-25; DECISIONS 62 (27)): NCBI's places at each load of a reported subject (the scope's cache and index, the data loader's m_Ids, the lookup; report::db_subject::ScopeWalk). Fixtures in multidb: zq7nH (R/pfoff/p4/review4/db), zhApP, zhBpP, zpApP (R/hr/bin/mkfix_hr.py), zlxL and nq_XB.fna, nq_X.fna (its first query) (R/hr/bin/hr1open.py --mkfix), pq_U.faa and nq_2.fna (mixdb2 review1), made with makeblastdb 2.17.0 -parse_seqids. Kind ncbi rows are frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0; the losat-rejection rows are holds that NCBI writes (exit 0), refused until hr-2 writes the holder's record.

column12: line DBID hr-1 (review 4 nf of pfoff-4, M1): a lookup that does not fail (vnP's unversioned ref|NM_100001|, prefetch off) beside zq7nH, whose line 1 holds ref|NP_100001.1| and line 2 gi|7109 (its Seq-align id): its Bioseq is made by line 2, so neither the scope nor m_Ids holds the subject's id and NCBI writes the subject; dev's static scan of every line refused it

line DBID hr-1 (open probe of the design, light calls): zlxL (ref|XM_000061.1| ^A ref|NM_100001.1|, other letters) is hit by the first query alone, nP's NM_100001.1 and NM_100000.1 by the second (BATCH_SIZE=1): no prefetch and slen alone: nothing loads a Bioseq, the light call gives each subject's own length (dev's static scan refused it)

line DBID hr-1 (open probe of the design, light calls): zlxL (ref|XM_000061.1| ^A ref|NM_100001.1|, other letters) is hit by the first query alone, nP's NM_100001.1 and NM_100000.1 by the second (BATCH_SIZE=1): the first query alone (nq_X.fna): its batch's report, which db.hr1.mb.light.mix.i writes before its refusal

line DBID hr-1 (open probe of the design, light calls): zlxL (ref|XM_000061.1| ^A ref|NM_100001.1|, other letters) is hit by the first query alone, nP's NM_100001.1 and NM_100000.1 by the second (BATCH_SIZE=1): the first batch (one Seq-align) prefetches zlxL, whose blob registers ref|NM_100001.1| in m_Ids; the second (two, prefetch off) loads NM_100001.1 by sseqid and NCBI writes zlxL's id and length (exit 0) | expect: also holds (where both are reported, NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 can write that sequence's names and letters for it) | ncbi-near: db.hr1.mb.light.first.i
